review.method: Agent manual review of all 161 flagged venue/title groups (212 occurrences) and 19 deliberately varied control groups. All occurrence descriptions compared, and every quoted excerpt checked against its own raw API occurrence. Labels were assigned before executing any proposed ingestion rule. Not independent human review, not blind validation, and not a population false-positive estimate.
review.selection: All original audit flags, plus deliberately selected legitimate comedy controls for drinks, games, karaoke, tours, music words, movie titles, variety and graduation/student showcases. Unselected snapshot records remain unreviewed, not assumed comedy.
review.genre_semantics: Whether the advertised event content includes comedy; comedy includes explicit parody and comedic hosting. A comedy film or comedy class may have comedy genre while not being a live audience show. Non-comedy means the detailed advertised programme establishes a different activity without comedy billing; this is evidence-based judgement, not proof nothing funny can ever happen.
review.public_availability_semantics: Public means the evidence advertises an audience event or open activity. Non_public covers booking promotions and closure notices. Unknown is retained where availability is not established.
review.lineup_limitations: Public lineup identities were retained in the snapshot but were not used to infer blocked comedians, canonical parents, deny-list status or verified comedian identity.
review.evidence_limitations: No external event detail pages were fetched for these labels. All genre evidence comes from preserved public API titles/descriptions, whose upstream extraction accuracy has not been independently verified. Empty descriptions and music-suggestive titles alone remain unknown. Source/native mappings are a separate read-only database capture, not genre evidence.
